description: A warm, open-plan foyer and staircase with a transitional luxury aesthetic. A broad open-tread staircase rises diagonally from lower left to upper right, with medium walnut-toned wood treads and a glass panel balustrade held by slim walnut handrails and posts. Below the staircase, a warm-lit area is visible with a tall sculptural decorative element or golden figurine against the wall. The staircase wall at right is smooth plaster in warm sand-beige, hung with a loose cluster of small framed artworks and photographs in mixed sizes and light wood or metal frames. To the right of the staircase base, a rectangular console table in warm walnut holds a small stack of books and decorative objects. A large potted tree in a ceramic planter anchors the foyer floor at left. The floor throughout is warm honey-toned wood. Multiple rounded globe or sphere forms in frosted alabaster or opal glass hang at staggered heights from thin cables suspended along the double-height void beside the staircase, each emitting a warm glowing radiance that fills the foyer with amber pools of illumination.
